assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Concentration
items.clue: Amount of solute divided by the volume of the whole solution.

items.label: Volumetric flask
items.clue: Glassware filled until the bottom of the meniscus sits on the mark.

items.label: Dilution
items.clue: Adding water, which changes the volume but not the amount of solute.

questions.stem: A one-carat diamond is pure carbon with a mass of 0.200 g. About how many carbon atoms does it contain? Data: Ar C 12.0; N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.
questions.explanation: n = 0.200 g ÷ the molar mass of C = 0.0167 mol. N = 0.0167 mol × N_A = 1.00 × 10²² atoms.

questions.stem: Ethyne, a welding gas, and benzene, a liquid, both contain 92.3% carbon and 7.7% hydrogen by mass. What is the molecular formula of benzene? Data: Ar H 1.0, C 12.0. Mr of benzene = 78.0.
questions.explanation: C: 92.3 ÷ 12 ≈ 7.7; H: 7.7 ÷ 1 ≈ 7.7. Ratio 1 : 1, empirical formula CH (about 13). x = 78 ÷ 13 = 6: C₆H₆.

questions.stem: A student adds 600.0 cm³ of water to 200.0 cm³ of 0.500 mol dm⁻³ NaCl(aq), giving 800.0 cm³ of solution. What is the concentration of NaCl in the diluted solution, in mol dm⁻³?
A fixed mass of an ideal gas occupies 2.00 × 10⁻³ m³ at 1.00 × 10⁵ Pa and 27 °C. It is compressed to 5.00 × 10⁻⁴ m³ and at the same time its temperature rises to 87 °C. What is its new pressure?
questions.explanation: p₂ = 1.00 × 10⁵ × 4.00 × (360/300) = 4.80 × 10⁵ Pa. Compressing and heating both raise the pressure.

questions.stem: The first ionisation energies of beryllium and boron are 900 kJ mol⁻¹ and 801 kJ mol⁻¹. Which explanation of the lower value for boron is correct?

options.text: Boron's electron is removed from a 2p orbital that already holds another electron.
Boron atoms are larger than beryllium atoms, so the outer electron is further away.
Boron's electron is removed from 2p, which is higher in energy than beryllium's 2s.
Boron's nuclear charge is shared among more electrons, so each is held less strongly.

questions.stem: Seawater contains about 1.29 g of magnesium ions, Mg²⁺, per dm³. How many moles of Mg²⁺ are in 250 cm³ of seawater? Data: Ar Mg 24.3.
A sealed aerosol can is left in a car on a sunny day. At 20 °C the gas inside is at 3.00 × 10⁵ Pa. The can warms to 70 °C; its volume stays constant. What happens to the pressure inside the can?

options.text: It rises to 3.5 times its starting value.
It stays the same, because the volume is fixed.
